claim.purpose: Add a fail-closed typed publication reconciliation path for an already-merged PR whose final head has exact review evidence

initial.title: Reconcile merged PR after a late reviewed-head advance
initial.goal: Allow truthful typed closeout when a merged PR head advanced after initial publication.
initial.required_outcome: A final reviewed merged head can be reconciled into publication evidence without weakening exact-revision review or fabricating terminal SHA truth.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Reconciliation requires an explicit merged PR and exact final reviewed head
AC-2: Repository, base, head, issue linkage, title, body, SHA, and merged state fail closed on drift
AC-3: Normal draft publication behavior is unchanged
AC-4: #5412 can proceed through normal readiness and closeout using truthful final-head evidence
invariants: Normal draft publication stays fail closed
No direct card or index edits
non_goals: No automatic acceptance of arbitrary late commits
initial.failure_policy: Reject unless the explicit GitHub PR is merged and its final head exactly matches the current clean reviewed revision.
authority_boundary: Independent Rust C-SDLC v2 publication and closeout path
initial.plan_summary: Add a narrow merged-publication reconciliation command and prove all identity and review gates.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Merged-head reconciliation and unchanged draft publication

review_prompts: Does the route require exact final-head review?
Can a wrong or unmerged PR be reconciled?
risks: A permissive merged-PR path could bypass exact review if identity validation is incomplete.
stop_conditions: Any need to fabricate terminal evidence
Any bypass of typed v2 state mutation
initial.task_boundary: Implement and prove only the narrow merged-head publication reconciliation needed for truthful closeout.
